releases.summaryEn: The first public Windows installer introduced the Champion Codex, local-first client integration, and update checks.
releases.summaryZh: 第一个公开 Windows 安装包带来了英雄图鉴、本地优先的客户端连接和版本检查。
addedEn: Published the first installable Windows beta.
Added configurable hotkeys and the initial desktop update flow.
addedZh: 发布第一个可安装的 Windows 测试版。
新增可配置快捷键和基础桌面更新流程。

releases.summaryEn: The first Mayhempedia test build connected the desktop companion to the League Client read-only interface.
releases.summaryZh: Mayhempedia 初始测试版打通了桌面伴侣与 League Client 只读接口。
addedEn: Added the initial Electron desktop companion.
Connected to League Client state without reading game memory or automating gameplay.
Added the first Champion Codex and ARAM build data views.
addedZh: 新增基础 Electron 桌面伴侣应用。
连接 League Client 状态，不读取游戏内存，也不自动操作游戏。
新增第一版英雄图鉴和 ARAM 路线数据视图。
